settings.subtext:
The terms on which we sell our products to you. Please read them before placing an order.

Last updated: 18 July 2026

settings.content:
1. About us

Qlose Ltd
Registered in England & Wales, company number 17311111
Registered office: 8 Shepherd Market, No. 613, London W1J 7JY
Email: hello@getqlose.com

These terms apply to every order placed through getqlose.com. Please read them before you order. By placing an order you agree to them.

2. Who we sell to

We currently sell and deliver to addresses in the United Kingdom only. You must be at least 18 to place an order.

3. How a contract is formed

When you place an order we will send an acknowledgement email. That email confirms we have received your order, but it is not acceptance. A contract between us is formed only when we send you an email confirming that your order has been dispatched. If we cannot accept your order — for example because an item is out of stock or we have identified a pricing error — we will tell you and refund any payment taken.

4. Our products

Product images on our site are for illustration. Small variations in colour and finish are normal and do not make a product faulty.

Our kits are oral care products, not medical devices intended to diagnose or treat disease. Nothing on our site is dental advice. If you have a dental or medical condition, speak to your dentist or doctor before changing your routine.

5. Price and payment

Prices are shown in pounds sterling and include VAT where applicable. Delivery costs are shown separately at checkout before you pay.

We take payment at the point of order for one-time purchases, and on each renewal date for subscriptions. If a payment fails we may retry it and will contact you.

We may change our prices from time to time. A change will never affect an order we have already accepted. For subscriptions, we will give you at least 30 days' notice by email before a price change takes effect, and you may cancel before it applies.

6. Delivery

Delivery times and costs are set out on our Shipping & Returns page. Delivery estimates are estimates, not guarantees.

Your order becomes your responsibility once it is delivered to the address you gave us. Risk passes to you on delivery; ownership passes once we have received payment in full.

If nobody is available, our delivery partner will follow its usual process — leaving the parcel in a safe place, with a neighbour, or at a local collection point.

7. Subscriptions

When you subscribe, you buy your first kit and then receive refills automatically on the cadence you chose, at the price shown when you subscribed.

  • You can pause, skip a delivery, change your cadence or cancel at any time from your account.
  • Changes take effect on your next renewal, provided you make them before that renewal is processed. Once an order has been processed we cannot stop it.
  • There is no minimum term and no cancellation fee.
  • We will email you before each renewal so you have time to make changes.

8. Your right to cancel, and returns

Your legal right to cancel, and how our hygiene seal affects it, is set out in full on our Returns & Cancellations page, which forms part of these terms.

9. Faulty goods and warranty

If something is faulty, misdescribed or not as agreed, you have legal rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015. Nothing in these terms limits those rights.

In addition, the electric toothbrush supplied in The Electric Kit carries a 12-month Qlose warranty from the date of delivery. If it develops a fault in normal use during that period, contact us and we will replace it. The warranty does not cover damage from misuse, accident, or normal wear of consumable parts such as brush heads.

10. Our liability

We are responsible for loss or damage you suffer that is a foreseeable result of us breaking these terms or failing to use reasonable care and skill. We are not responsible for loss or damage that is not foreseeable.

We do not exclude or limit our liability in any way where it would be unlawful to do so. This includes liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, and for breach of your legal rights in relation to the products.

We do not supply products for business use, and we have no liability to you for business loss.

11. Events outside our control

We are not liable for delays or failures caused by events outside our reasonable control. If such an event occurs we will contact you and either extend the delivery timeframe or, if the delay is substantial, allow you to cancel and receive a refund.

12. Complaints

If something has gone wrong, email hello@getqlose.com with your order number. We aim to reply within one working day.

13. Other important terms

We may transfer our rights and obligations under these terms to another organisation, and will tell you if we do. You may only transfer your rights to someone else with our written agreement.

If a court finds part of these terms unlawful, the remaining terms continue in force.

These terms are governed by English law and you can bring legal proceedings in the English courts. If you live in Scotland or Northern Ireland, you may also bring proceedings in your own courts.
